description: Platform-governed identifier, temporal, and trust vocabulary registry for cross-domain data-product contracts.

identifiers.description: Canonical portfolio identifier used across source-data, performance, and risk products.
Canonical benchmark identifier used for linked benchmark resolution and benchmark-shaped products.
Canonical position identifier for position-level source and derived analytics products.
Canonical instrument identifier used for holdings, exposure, enrichment, and reference products.
Canonical issuer identifier used where products publish issuer-level exposure or enrichment context.
Canonical index identifier used for benchmark market-series and index-series products.
Canonical risk-free curve identifier for governed risk-free source series.
Durable calculation handle for async-capable analytics products.
Tenant identifier used for policy, access, and trust context across governed products.
Correlation identifier propagated for cross-service traceability and supportability.
Snapshot identifier for point-in-time portfolio state and downstream reproducibility.

temporal_semantics.description: Business-effective date used to resolve a governed product view.
Observation date used for valuation, market-series, and benchmark exposure rows.
UTC timestamp at which a governed product payload was generated.
Timestamp at which the upstream source observation was recorded.
Timestamp at which a source event or batch was ingested into Lotus.

freshness_classes.meaning: Expected to reflect current source state without a scheduled batch delay.
Expected to refresh multiple times within the business day.
Expected to refresh once per governed business day or as-of cycle.
Expected to refresh as part of a scheduled batch or workflow run.
Expected to refresh when governed source events arrive.

completeness_statuses.meaning: The product is expected to deliver its full governed payload shape.
The product may deliver a bounded but intentionally incomplete payload with explicit diagnostics.
The product may be unavailable because a required dependency or control failed.
The product cannot currently attest to completeness status.

reconciliation_statuses.meaning: The product or its source inputs reconcile to the governing evidence baseline.
The product or its source inputs failed a required reconciliation check.
Reconciliation is not required for this product family.

data_quality_statuses.meaning: Required data-quality checks passed for the governed product or source input.
The product is usable, but a non-blocking data-quality warning exists.
The product failed a required data-quality gate.
